combo_label: At the Doctors × Chocolate & Sweets × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: What an American child calls the sweets a British one buys
The amount of syrup the label tells you to swallow at bedtime
Full of clatter and blare, and best measured in decibels
Quick needle in the upper arm, offered every autumn before flu season
Tom Baker's Doctor offered them from a paper bag: soft chewy infant shapes
Gibberish; also the sort of verse Edward Lear made his name with
Graduated barrel with a plunger, filled from a small glass vial
Shake these tiny coloured strands over a frosted cupcake
Raw and tender, the way a heel goes when a new shoe rubs
Virtuous and well-behaved, the sort who collects gold stars
Knees knocking, he faces the dragon regardless
Deep amber sweet, boiled hard yet sticky enough to glue the jaws shut
